what: FYI from compile-time-sched: blaze_codegen::flight (in-memory single flight across concurrent builds of one Memo) adds no store or cache key. Each build still puts a function template under its own keys::template(stored) or keys::release(blob) key, byte-for-byte what it puts alone (asserted in driver/tests/flight.rs). Flights are keyed by those same keys and live only in the daemon Memo.
